metadata.title: Cinematic Portrait with Bold Condensed Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast cinematic portrait of a woman in a wide-brimmed hat, where the upper face is cast in deep shadow, emphasizing vibrant red lips and blonde hair. The composition is anchored by large, stacked, condensed sans-serif typography in the lower-left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The vibrant red of the lips mirrors the primary title text color.
The harsh shadow line from the hat brim creates a geometric division across the face.
The verticality of the condensed font echoes the vertical flow of the hair strands.
coreInvariants: Vivid red focal point on the lips

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up profile, slightly off-center to the right, filling the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red lips serve as the central visual anchor, leading the eye down to the bold text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the shadowed face, moves down to the red lips, and finally rests on the large block of text in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The shadowed area under the hat and the blurred background provide breathing room for the subject's features.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted beige and desaturated browns in the hair and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep near-black shadows providing structural depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crimson red used exclusively for the lips and the primary title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low overall saturation with a high-value, high-saturation pop in the red elements.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy tones, blacks, and one specific red

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the lower torso/hair area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same-family variation using color and scale to differentiate hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight for the display role.
Classic condensed sans-serif that matches the clean, modern-vintage look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic close-up portrait of a woman with long blonde hair wearing a wide-brimmed hat. Use harsh top-down lighting so the hat casts a deep shadow over her eyes, leaving only her nose and vibrant red lips visible. Apply a vintage film grain and a muted, warm color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a two-line text block in the bottom-left corner. The top line should be a large, bold, extra-condensed sans-serif in crimson red. The second line should be a medium-sized condensed sans-serif in off-white, left-aligned with the first line.

verificationChecks: Is the top half of the face in deep shadow?
Are the lips a vibrant, saturated red?
Is the text block left-justified in the bottom corner?
Is the primary title text red and the secondary text off-white?

adjustableVariables: Degree of shadow opacity over the eyes
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness

mustAchieve: Cohesive color link between lips and text
avoid: Default system fonts like Arial or Helvetica

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red of the text matches the red of the lips.
Check that the shadow line from the hat is sharp and deliberate.
Verify that the text does not obscure the main facial features (lips/nose).
Confirm the overall mood is moody and cinematic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast shadow-play portrait with a bottom-weighted, color-coordinated condensed typographic block.
